Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Starters first

When you sit down, a salad and several small plates of vegetable starters arrive. 23 reviews mention the meze.

Slow cooked dishes

Lamb in several ways and dishes that combine pulses and vegetables with meat, such as meat with okra.

From the grill

Local dishes grilled on the spot, sheftalia among them, with tahini on the side.

Half portions

Half portions are available, so you can try more dishes. Guests also mention vegan options.

At the table and at the door

Photos from the Google listing of the tavern.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Like at home

Guests describe home made Cypriot food, freshly prepared, the way grandma used to cook.

Full of locals

Popular for lunch, also for business lunches. It gets busy, so guests recommend booking a table.

Fast service

Guests write that the food comes out fast and the waiters are friendly and efficient.

A family tavern since 1985

The sign says 1985, and guests describe a family restaurant that has been around for decades. Inside under the arches or by the windows with plants, guests eat traditional Cypriot food. Open Monday to Saturday for lunch and dinner.

What guests say

Three of 422 Google reviews, 290 of them with five stars.

“Excellent local tavern to try out authentic Cypriot dishes. When you sit, they bring a salad and various plates of vegetable starters. Then there is a selection of already cooked or grilled on the spot local dishes. Food is fresh and delucious. Service is prompt.”

Google review
“Traditional Cypriot food of outstanding quality! The place is cozy and feels like an escape in the middle of the town. The service is excellent, and the prices are very affordable!”

Google review
“A cozy place, where you can experience home-made Cypriot food. Unassuming from outside, the food will always make you return.”
